mechanism.claim: The direction owning the widest and most heavily traded constituent auctions reflects sponsored price discovery rather than low-participation wicks. When signed range-energy times turnover polarity enters its upper magnitude tail during elevated variation, follow that native polarity for eight hours.
mechanism.why_distinct: HVVRCR correlates signed returns with log volume; RBEFR divides total range variance by body variance; HVDVBR selects one maximum-volume bar. HVRPPR integrates direction across all five-minute auctions under the joint measure Parkinson range energy times quote turnover, and reuses no prior event set or control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily onsets from signed range-turnover geometry are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_aggregation: 96 exact consecutive groups; OHLC first/max/min/last and quote turnover sum
features.bar_return: log(five-minute close/open), with sign zero allowed
features.range_turnover_weight: parkinson_energy*five-minute quote turnover, finite nonnegative; full-block sum strict positive
features.range_participation_polarity: sum(weight*sign(bar_return))/sum(weight), finite in [-1,1] and strict nonzero
features.polarity_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(polarity) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sum squared log(close/open) over 480 one-minute rows, finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.decision: D after the full source path completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent native signed measure of range-energy-weighted participation

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no aggregation, energy, weighting, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
